item.title: From a Model’s Random-Number Fingerprint: A Study of LLM Reasoning Circuits
item.dc:creator: Yingjie Tan
item.description: Starting from a stable fingerprint in random-number generation, this post identifies attention heads that transport candidate information. Their causal effect appears when the answer is unresolved, generalizes across tasks and phrasings, and persists under interventions that interrupt normal reasoning. Head TV can then detect unreliable reasoning and trigger additional reasoning to improve performance.
